subject: Next: 75m model-serving deep dive — proposed dates & attendee ops mapping

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & 75m model-serving deep dive — proposed slots

Hi Alex / Sophie —

Great to meet yesterday — quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Goal: validate latency/cost tradeoffs for model-serving on your batch + near-real-time pipelines and map required infra (KV cache, batching, autoscale tiers).
- Success criteria you mentioned: <20ms median p50 for inference, predictable cost per 1M tokens, and auditability for PHI flows.
- Recommended next step: 60–90 minute technical deep dive (we usually run a 75m format) with your ML infra + SRE + product owner and our serving/runtime engineers.

Proposed 75m slots (all times PT):
- Tue, Dec 15 — 09:00–10:15
- Wed, Dec 16 — 13:00–14:15
- Fri, Dec 18 — 11:00–12:15

Attached: draft agenda (tdx-proposed-agenda.pdf) that covers goals, current infra snapshot, data flows and redlines, and a 30m runthrough of a sample workload. Can you confirm which slot works and who will join from your side (ML lead, infra/SRE, product/security)?

If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll adapt. I’ll loop in Marcus (serving/runtime) and Kimberly (security & onboarding) on the confirmed slot.

Thanks —
Evelyn

Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical

Attachments (referenced): tdx-proposed-agenda.pdf

Two quick asks: can you include a brief section on private deployment (VPC/on-prem) options and a short run-of-show for the sample workload so we can prep network/keys?

Appreciate it — I’ll hold the slot tentative.

Perfect — locking Wed Dec 16 13:00–14:15 PT for a 75m deep dive. I’ve attached the calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) and the updated agenda; I added a 10-min security window for Julian.

Marcus — are you able to lead the runthrough of the serving/runtime architecture and a short live demonstration (we'll show a 1M token sample and a low-latency path)? If helpful, Marcus can show:
- current kernel selection behavior,
- batching & KV cache strategy for near-real-time, and
- fallback policies / quantized model variants for capacity constraints.

Kimberly — please bring any onboarding/security checklist items we should confirm during the call (networking, KMS, audit logs).

Sophie / Alex — in advance, please share:
- a brief diagram of your current inference path (S3 -> transformer endpoint -> downstream service) OR a Drive link to the architecture snapshot;
- sample QPS and typical sequence length distributions (p50/p95);
- any compliance constraints (PHI redaction, retention windows) you want covered.

I’ve also attached a one-page precall checklist (precall-checklist.md) to help your SRE/security folks prep keys and IP allowlists.

Thanks all — calendar invite will show up from my account.

Evelyn
